# A node's two-way prop read through its handle held anywhere but the `#id`
# itself reads what the call site bound it to, as the read through the `#id`
# does (two_way_prop_read_through_id_runs.txt): a local initialized from the
# `#id` is the `#id` (aliasHandleLocals), and a function reading a prop
# through a node parameter is handed the prop (handPropsForNodeParams). The
# functions have block bodies, which the optimizer's inliner leaves called.

sngl test --platform=none app.sngl
stdout 'ok +10 tests, 0 failures'
sngl test --platform=html app.sngl
stdout 'ok +10 tests, 0 failures'
sngl test --platform=bubbletea --language=go app.sngl
stdout 'ok +10 tests, 0 failures'
sngl test --platform=fyne --language=go app.sngl
stdout 'ok +10 tests, 0 failures'
sngl test --platform=gtk4 --language=go app.sngl
stdout 'ok +10 tests, 0 failures'
sngl test --platform=android --language=kotlin app.sngl
stdout 'ok +10 tests, 0 failures'

-- app.sngl --
import test "sngl:test"
import ui "sngl:ui"

func grab(x ui.input) string {
    var v = x.value
    return v
}

func both(x ui.input, y ui.input) string {
    var v = "{x.value}/{y.value}"
    return v
}

func onward(y ui.input) => grab(y) + "!"

func caption(x ui.text) string {
    var v = x.value
    return v
}

func shout(x ui.input) {
    x.value = x.value + "!"
}

component row(start string) ui.node {
    var name = start
    var got = "none"

    ui.input #f(:value=name)
    ui.button #read(text="read", @click { got = grab(f) })
    ui.text #seen(value=got)
}

component held ui.node {
    var name = "ada"
    var got = "none"
    var typed = "none"

    ui.input #f(:value=name, @input { typed = grab(f) })
    ui.input #g()
    ui.text #t(value="cap {name}")
    ui.button #plain(text="plain", @click {
        var h = f
        got = h.value
    })
    ui.button #local(text="local", @click {
        var h = f
        if name != "" {
            var h2 = h
            got = h2.value
        }
    })
    ui.button #shown(text="shown", @click { got = grab(f) })
    ui.button #cell(text="cell", @click { got = both(f, g) })
    ui.button #passed(text="passed", @click { got = onward(f) })
    ui.button #text(text="text", @click { got = caption(t) })
    ui.button #write(text="write", @click {
        var h = f
        h.value = "zed"
        got = h.value
    })
    ui.button #shouted(text="shouted", @click {
        shout(f)
        got = grab(f)
    })
    ui.button #set(text="set", @click { name = "grace" })
    ui.text #seen(value=got)
    ui.text #heard(value=typed)
    for var s = ["p", "q"] {
        row #r(start=s)
    }
}

func testALocalReadsTheBinding(t test.Test, c held) {
    c.set.click()
    c.plain.click()
    t.assert(c.seen.value == "grace")
}

func testAChainedLocalReadsTheBinding(t test.Test, c held) {
    c.set.click()
    c.local.click()
    t.assert(c.seen.value == "grace")
}

func testAParamReadsTheBinding(t test.Test, c held) {
    c.set.click()
    c.shown.click()
    t.assert(c.seen.value == "grace")
}

func testAnUnboundCellReadsThroughAParam(t test.Test, c held) {
    c.g.input("bee")
    c.cell.click()
    t.assert(c.seen.value == "ada/bee")
}

func testAParamPassedOnReadsTheBinding(t test.Test, c held) {
    c.set.click()
    c.passed.click()
    t.assert(c.seen.value == "grace!")
}

func testAOneWayPropReadsThroughAParam(t test.Test, c held) {
    c.set.click()
    c.text.click()
    t.assert(c.seen.value == "cap grace")
}

func testAWriteThroughALocalLandsOnTheBinding(t test.Test, c held) {
    c.write.click()
    t.assert(c.seen.value == "zed")
    t.assert(c.t.value == "cap zed")
}

func testAWriteThroughAParamThenARead(t test.Test, c held) {
    c.shouted.click()
    t.assert(c.seen.value == "ada!")
}

func testAHandlerReadsTheReportThroughAParam(t test.Test, c held) {
    c.f.input("bee")
    t.assert(c.heard.value == "bee")
}

func testEachCopyReadsItsOwnThroughAParam(t test.Test, c held) {
    c.r[1].read.click()
    t.assert(c.r[1].seen.value == "q")
    c.r[0].read.click()
    t.assert(c.r[0].seen.value == "p")
}
